ふぉふぉふぉ流石流石
では……
儂の本当の姿を見せるとするかのう
column2:
我が名は ローム・ボスフォレームス・ハイラル

かつて この地に在った国ハイラル……
その最後の王だ
column3:
この国は100年前大厄災によって滅んだ……
と言うたな
儂はその時に命を失い今や魂だけの存在となってしまった……
column4:
今こそ話そう……
100年前何があったのか……
column5:
記憶の確かでないお主に全てを語れば混乱する……

そう考え儂は仮の姿をとっていたのだ

column1:
"Well done there, young one!Now, then... The time has come
to show you who I truly am.
column2: I was King Rhoam Bosphoramus Hyrule.I was...the last leader of Hyrule.A kingdom which no longer exists.
column3:
The Great Calamity was merciless...It devastated everything in its path, lo,
a century ago.It was then that my life was taken away from me.And since that time, here I have remained,
in spirit form.
column4: I think you are now ready.Ready to hear what happened 100 years ago.
column5:
I did not think it wise to overwhelm you while
your memory was still fragile.So rather than that, I thought it best
to assume a temporary form.
